bullets.text: Autonomous Logistics Trial - The Port of Tyne successfully tested self-driving vehicles, advancing UK port automation efforts.
Belden Acquires RUCKUS - Belden's $1.85bn acquisition of **RUCKUS** enhances its networking solutions portfolio.
EE's AI Scam Guard - **EE** launches upgraded Scam Guard with AI Triple-Lock Protection to combat rising scams.
VMO2's Solar Power Deal - **VMO2** signs a 10-year agreement for renewable energy from a Suffolk solar farm.
New Subsea Cable AUÐUR - **Farice** plans a new subsea cable to enhance connectivity between Iceland and Scotland.
AI in Telecom Billing - Sarathi's EarnBill platform offers flexible billing solutions for modern telecom challenges.
